blocks.text: Cells ki daryaft (discovery) aur phir cell ke andar ki banawat (internal structure) ki mazeed studies microscope ke istemal par hi mumkin hui. Microscopy woh technique hai jis mein microscope se aisi cheezen dekhi aur parhi jati hain jo itni chhoti hain ke nangi aankh (naked eye) se nazar nahi aatin. Microscopes lenses aur light ya electron beams se specimens (namoone) ko bara (magnify) aur roshan (illuminate) karte hain.

blocks.title: Magnification and Resolution
blocks.text:
Yeh microscope ki do sab se aham khususiyat (characteristics) hain.
Magnification: microscope ki woh salahiyat (ability) jis se woh cheez ka image bara kar deta hai. Har lens ki magnification alag hoti hai. Ise 'X' se likhte hain, jo batata hai ke image asal size se kitne guna bara nazar aata hai. Misal: 10X lens 1 µm ki cheez ko 10 µm jitna bara dikhata hai. Microscope ki kul (total) magnification tamam lenses ki magnification ko aapas mein zarb (multiply) kar ke milti hai.
Resolution: microscope ki woh salahiyat jis se woh kisi cheez par bohat qareeb do nuqton ko alag alag dikha sake. Resolution jitni zyada ho, utni bareek detail nazar aati hai. Insani aankh ki resolution taqreeban 0.1 mm hai, jabke light microscope taqreeban 250 nm (nanometres) tak ki detail alag dikha sakta hai.
